notes.title: Update 1.0c
notes.content:
Fixed the incremental achievements:
The "100 Levels" achievement now unlocks based on the total number of levels you’ve completed (you might need to finish one more level to trigger it).
The other incremental achievements require starting from scratch, as we didn’t track the necessary data previously.

Thank you ! See you in the Nonoverse !

notes.title: Update 1.0d
notes.content: Fix some translation and world progression (Spain).

notes.title: Update 1.0c
notes.content:
Quality of Life:
  - The paint tool is now the default option when entering a Nonogram.

Bug Fixes:
  - Procedural levels are now playable.
  - Pressing the spacebar at the end of a tutorial no longer causes a crash.

Thank you for all the feedback! See you in the Nonoverse !

notes.title: Nonogram 3D: Mega Puzzle Official 1.0 Release!
notes.content:
After many many months of work, the game is now available!

It features the 200+ handcrafted puzzles AND our procedural puzzle generator for infinite replayability.

If you want to help us make this release as successfull as possible, don't hesitate to:
- Leave a review
- Give feedback on the Steam forums
- Or on our official Discord server (https://discord.gg/cfaeZmJyYx)

And share the game with people around you that might be interested!

It's been a weird, fun, difficult, wonderful experience for us and it's not over! We want to keep perfecting the game, so thank you for your help and patience!

Lou
- Seven Jams

notes.title: Launch Update
notes.content: First Update, last minute bug and translation fix !

notes.title: Numbers and Feedback from the Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

This Steam Next Fest has been a great success, thank you all for your trust and participation!

With almost [b]1000 [/b]unique new players that tried out the demo, we've doubled our wishlists to pass the [b]1500 [/b]mark!

There's also still around [b]1000 [/b]people that have added the demo to their account without testing it yet, if it's your case don't hesitate to take a couple of minutes out of your day to check out our progress towards release!

Our last objective to reach that is still ongoing is to reach [b]50 reviews[/b] on Steam. We're currently at [b]44[/b], only [b]6 [/b]are missing to smash our target! If you haven't already, please take a couple of minutes to write a quick review to help us get there!

We've received a lot of [b]positive feedback[/b] on the game's content, as well as multiple requests about game [b]functionnalities [/b]like using mouse buttons directly to break blocs or customizing some of the inputs. That's what we're focusing on for the next few weeks of the project!

The next update is coming soon, on [b]November 5th[/b], with many Quality of Life changes as well as a couple of [b]new levels[/b] for those that have already finished the demo but can't wait for the full release!

Thanks again for your support during this event, we hope we can finish building the best game possible for you on the release date of [b]December 9th[/b]!


Lou
- Seven Jams

notes.title: Welcome to the Nonogram 3D: Mega Puzzle Community Steam Page!
notes.content:
